# @vanya/ui — Vanya Arc / UI

> Public React design system with a single Russian longread, reusable components, real examples and browser-native navigation. Only public information is documented.

## Overview
- [Single longread](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/): Human reference, semantic HTML and interactive demos.
- [Longread Markdown](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/index.md): Text without JavaScript.
- [Identity](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/identity.md): Vanya Arc parent brand, / UI product, original VA mark and reusable React components.
- [Loading states](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/loading.md): Skeletons, aria-busy, reduced motion, error and retry, examples.\n- [Typography](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/typography.md): Semantic type tokens, font families, readable lengths, mobile and zoom.
- [Writing and editorial](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/writing.md): Local product copy rules and links to original methods (book reference-only; redaktura-skills CC BY 4.0).
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Normative rules for conflicts, access, keycap typography, opt-out, WCAG 2.1.4 and real showcase commands.
- [Navigation rule](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/navigation.md): URLs, browser history and links.

## Reference
- [Components](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/components.md): Real exported React components and source links.
- [Tokens](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/tokens.md): Generated theme tokens.
- [Composition](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/composition.md): Reusable interface patterns.
- [Workspace scrolling](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/workspaces.md): Scroll owners and sticky context.
- [Installation](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/installation.md): How to use @vanya/ui.
- [Sources, quotations and required attribution](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/sources.md): How to record primary sources, distinguish short quotes from CC-licensed adaptations, and avoid relicensing third-party content.
- [Third-party licenses and attribution](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/third-party.md): React, Lucide/Feather, fonts and credited Agent Skills.
- [Built JavaScript dependency licenses](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/licenses.txt): Auto-generated full notices for deployed Vite bundle.
- [Licensing scopes](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/licensing.md): MIT software, selected CC BY research, protected Vanya Arc art and historical grants.
- [Canonical brand source](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-arc-brand): V→A artwork, SVG and React lockups, colors, typography and research.
- [UI brand integration compatibility reference](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/brand.md): pointer to canonical brand repo.
- [Brand and trademark use](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-arc-brand/blob/main/BRAND.md): How to cite and display the official sign without misrepresenting affiliation.
- [Vanya UI MIT license](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/LICENSE.txt): Copyright 2026 Vanya Afanasov.
- [Publication safety](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/publication-safety.md): Public-source boundary.

## Source
- [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-ui): Source, tests and mixed-license scope (original source code MIT; selected research CC BY 4.0).
- [Extended machine-readable reference](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/llms-full.txt): Generated tokens and export index.

This is a navigation aid for agents, not an indexing or ranking guarantee.
